notes: Fresh checks for the USGS 2024 Minerals Yearbook global facilities table loaded 11 Nov 2026 (source_system USGS_MYB2024). Not part of the gate.

questions.q: Which lithium mines and plants in Australia have capacity figures in your data?

truth.n: SELECT count(DISTINCT p.facility_key) FROM core.facility_capacity_published p JOIN core.occurrences o USING (occurrence_id) WHERE p.source_system = 'USGS_MYB2024' AND o.country_name = 'Australia' AND p.commodity_name ILIKE '%lithium%'

questions.judge: Uses the USGS 2024 Minerals Yearbook global facilities table (source USGS_MYB2024, data year 2024) for Australian lithium facilities, with capacities and product/measure as published (e.g. spodumene concentrate gross weight vs Li content). Credits USGS 2024 Minerals Yearbook. Says the list may be incomplete (facilities located only to a state were not loaded) and positions are approximate (town). Does not add mine and plant capacities. Does not invent figures.

questions.q: What is the latest capacity data you have for Indonesian nickel smelters?

truth.n: SELECT count(*) FROM core.facility_list('Indonesia', 'nickel') WHERE stage_group NOT IN ('Mine', 'Brine operation')

questions.judge: The question is about SMELTERS, so the answer should list Indonesia's nickel PROCESSING lines - smelters and other processing plants such as the Obi Island HPAL/MHP and sulphate plants (the truth figure counts these processing lines across releases); mine lines are optional and their absence is not a failure. Uses the newest figure per facility: 2024 Minerals Yearbook figures where the 2024 table has the facility, and older (2018 Southwest Asia release) figures only for facilities the 2024 table lacks - each row labelled with its data year/release (a split of the headline count by release is optional, but if given it must match the answer's own rows). A mine line and a smelter/plant line at the same site (e.g. Weda Bay mine and smelter, Sorowako mine and smelter) are separate facilities, not duplicates. Shows capacities with product and measure (e.g. matte Ni content). Notes the list may be incomplete and that Indonesia's industry keeps growing. Credits USGS. Does not sum different measures or stages, and does not show the same plant twice with two years.

questions.q: List the copper smelters and refineries in Germany with their capacities.

truth.n: SELECT count(DISTINCT p.facility_key) FROM core.facility_capacity_published p JOIN core.occurrences o USING (occurrence_id) WHERE o.country_name = 'Germany' AND p.commodity_name ILIKE '%copper%' AND p.stage_group IN ('Smelter','Refinery','Other processing plant')

questions.judge: Lists the German copper smelters/refineries in the database from the USGS 2024 Minerals Yearbook table with capacities, measure and the 2024 data year. KNOWN DATA GAP: only the Lunen line is loaded; the Hamburg plants (Aurubis) are not in the database. An answer that lists only Lunen and says Hamburg (or other German plants) is not in the data or that the list is incomplete is CORRECT - it does not need to explain why, and saying other Aurubis operations may be missing is acceptable. Credits USGS. Says positions are approximate. Does not invent facilities or capacity figures.
